title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.09153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. translated_title: 程序图：面向大语言模型智能体的自演化执行结构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署为智能体，进行长程规划并通过外部工具执行操作。大多数智能体通过在不断累积的历史记录上进行无约束生成来选择动作，这使得“做什么、以什么顺序做、在什么条件下做”的程序性知识处于隐式状态。随着轨迹变长，智能体可能会迷失目标、乱序调用工具，并重复无效的操作。我们提出了程序图：正如知识图谱将事实知识组织为用于回答“是什么”问题的（实体，关系，实体）三元组一样，程序图将程序性知识组织为用于回答“该做什么”问题的（程序，关系，程序）三元组。在每个决策步骤中，该框架会定位智能体的活跃节点，然后由引导模型将周围的子图转化为步骤级的情境引导，这种引导会对求解器的下一个动作产生偏向作用，而非直接指定它。该图（原文摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“程序图”框架，将程序性知识组织为（程序，关系，程序）三元组结构，通过引导模型在每步决策时将子图转化为情境引导来约束大语言模型智能体的行动，从而解决长程任务中目标迷失、工具乱序调用和重复无效操作的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Procedural Graphs, which organize procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets, and uses a guidance model to convert surrounding subgraphs into step-level situational guidance that prevents LLM agents from losing objectives, invoking tools out of order, or repeating unproductive actions in long-horizon tasks.
